defect.description: The new condition is not valid Python: `!` is not a negation operator (it should be `not hmac.compare_digest(...)`), so src/auth.py raises SyntaxError on import and every caller and test of is_authorized breaks.

review_items: src/auth.py:16 — short-circuit `or` skips password comparison when username differs, leaking timing
src/auth.py:3 — import order nit (hmac before dataclasses)
votes.justification: The review quotes the faulty `!hmac.compare_digest(...)` condition at src/auth.py:16 and treats it as semantically valid. It complains only about short-circuit timing and never notes that `!` is invalid Python and causes a SyntaxError. It points at the right code but not the defect itself.
